intent.user_prompt: Generate an 8-bit FPGA RTL project that implements a small synchronous FIFO with ready/valid flow control.
intent.design_goal: Implement a small synchronous FIFO buffering 8-bit data words with independent write and read valid/ready handshakes, single clock domain, and safe full/empty flow control.
assumptions: Single clock domain (100 MHz) with active-low synchronous reset.
Both write and read interfaces use valid/ready handshaking.
FIFO depth defaults to 16 entries (power-of-two) to allow simple wrap-around pointer arithmetic.
Data width is 8 bits as specified.
First-word-fall-through behavior is not required; standard registered FIFO semantics with pointer-based storage.
Storage is inferred as a small register-based array; BRAM is not mandated for this depth.

components.intent: Single-clock synchronous FIFO with valid/ready flow control on both write and read sides, using pointer-based storage and occupancy tracking for full/empty derivation.

one read per cycle when rd_valid and rd_ready are both high

scenarios.name: single_write_read
scenarios.description: Write one word then read it back, checking data integrity through the FIFO.

scenarios.description: Write until FIFO reaches depth and verify wr_ready deasserts at full.

scenarios.name: fifo_ordering
scenarios.description: Write a sequence of words and read them back, verifying first-in-first-out order.
scenarios.pass_condition: Read data sequence matches written data sequence in order.

scenarios.name: backpressure
scenarios.description: Hold rd_ready low while writing and verify data is retained until reads resume.

intent.user_prompt: Generate an 8-bit FPGA RTL project that implements a small streaming FIR filter.
intent.design_goal: Define a small 8-bit streaming FIR filter architecture with valid/ready flow control, synchronous active-low reset, fixed coefficients, and area-first implementation suitable for a generic open-source Verilog FPGA flow.
assumptions: The FIR filter uses 4 fixed taps with symmetric coefficients [1, 2, 2, 1].
Input samples are unsigned 8-bit values.
The internal accumulator is wider than the input to avoid intermediate overflow.
The exported output is 8 bits and uses truncation from the scaled accumulator unless later implementation requirements specify saturation or rounding.
The design accepts one input sample per clock when both input valid and input ready are asserted.
Backpressure from the output interface stalls sample acceptance and preserves architectural state.

one filtered output sample per cycle after pipeline fill when downstream ready is asserted
one transferred output sample per cycle when m_axis_valid and m_axis_ready are both asserted

notes: Small fixed-coefficient multiplications are expected to map to LUT fabric rather than DSP blocks.
The 4-sample delay line is expected to use flip-flops rather than block RAM.

intent.user_prompt: Generate an 8-bit sobel_threshold FPGA RTL project.
intent.design_goal: Implement a parameterized 8-bit streaming Sobel edge detector followed by threshold comparison for a generic Verilog FPGA target at 100 MHz.
assumptions: Input pixels are unsigned 8-bit grayscale samples delivered in raster scan order.
The design uses a valid/ready streaming protocol on both input and output.
IMG_WIDTH and IMG_HEIGHT are compile-time parameters used for line buffering and frame boundary handling.
Boundary pixels without a complete 3x3 neighborhood produce a zero edge result.
The threshold input is sampled with each accepted output decision and compared against the Sobel magnitude approximation.
Sobel magnitude is computed as abs(Gx) + abs(Gy) and saturated before threshold comparison.
Reset is synchronous active-low as required by the target contract.

intent.user_prompt: Generate an 8-bit FPGA RTL project that joins two input streams, accumulates joined samples, and exposes one output stream.
intent.design_goal: Implement a composed dual-stream valid-ready pipeline that buffers two 8-bit input streams, joins paired samples, accumulates each joined sample into an 8-bit running sum, and presents the accumulated stream through an output stage.
assumptions: Input samples are unsigned 8-bit values.
The stream_join component emits one joined sample only when both input streams have a valid sample and downstream ready is asserted.
The joined sample is an 8-bit modulo sum of the paired input samples.
The accumulator_core updates an 8-bit modulo running sum on accepted joined samples.
All sequential state is clocked by clk and synchronously reset by active-low rst_n.
The design targets one transfer per cycle when both inputs are valid and the output is ready.

intent.user_prompt: Generate an 8-bit FPGA RTL project that accepts reward, value, next_value, gamma, and alpha inputs, computes TD error, and emits an updated value stream.
intent.design_goal: Define a composed 8-bit temporal-difference update datapath with valid-ready streaming, tuple capture, discount calculation, TD error computation, update calculation, and registered output staging for a generic open-source Verilog FPGA target.
assumptions: DATA_WIDTH is 8 bits for reward, value, next_value, gamma, alpha, td_error, and updated_value top-level payloads.
reward, value, next_value, td_error, and updated_value use signed two's-complement fixed-point integer interpretation at the architectural boundary.
gamma and alpha use unsigned Q0.8 fractional interpretation.
discounted_next_value is computed as the DATA_WIDTH result of gamma multiplied by next_value with fractional scaling applied internally.
td_error is computed as reward plus discounted_next_value minus value, with implementation-defined saturation or wrapping to DATA_WIDTH unless later refined.
updated_value is computed as value plus alpha multiplied by td_error with fractional scaling applied internally, with implementation-defined saturation or wrapping to DATA_WIDTH unless later refined.
Reset is synchronous active-low as required by the target platform.
The composed pipeline is intended to accept one input tuple per cycle when downstream ready permits.

parameters.intent: Payload width for all external numeric ports.

registers.intent: Registered updated value presented on the output stream.

fsms.intent: Tracks whether output_stage is empty or holding a valid TD update result.

components.name: td_input_stage
components.intent: Capture input valid-ready tuples and provide stable reward, value, next_value, gamma, and alpha operands to downstream compute stages.

components.name: discount_core
components.intent: Compute discounted_next_value from gamma and next_value for the TD error expression.

components.name: td_update_core
components.intent: Compute TD error and updated value from captured operands and discounted next value.

components.name: stream_stage
components.intent: Register TD update outputs and provide valid-ready backpressure to the input capture stage.

timing.throughput: one accepted input tuple per cycle when input_stage and output_stage are ready
one discounted next-value result per valid captured tuple
one TD update result per valid captured tuple
one output tuple per cycle when out_ready is asserted or the output stage is empty

scenarios.name: reset_behavior
scenarios.description: Drive rst_n low on clk edges and verify output valid state and captured tuple state reset to empty.
scenarios.pass_condition: out_valid is deasserted after reset and no stale td_error or updated_value transfer is reported.

scenarios.name: single_tuple_update
scenarios.description: Apply one valid input tuple with out_ready asserted and compare td_error and updated_value against the fixed-point TD update model.
scenarios.pass_condition: One output transfer occurs with expected td_error and updated_value.

scenarios.name: back_to_back_tuples
scenarios.description: Apply consecutive valid input tuples while out_ready remains asserted.
scenarios.pass_condition: The design produces one ordered output tuple per accepted input tuple with no bubbles after pipeline fill.

scenarios.name: output_backpressure
scenarios.description: Hold out_ready low while an output tuple is valid, then release it.
scenarios.pass_condition: out_valid remains asserted, td_error and updated_value remain stable, and in_ready reflects inability to overwrite the held result.

scenarios.name: signed_td_error_cases
scenarios.description: Exercise cases where reward plus discounted_next_value is less than value and cases where it is greater than value.
scenarios.pass_condition: td_error matches the architectural signed fixed-point reference behavior.

scenarios.name: alpha_gamma_extremes
scenarios.description: Exercise gamma and alpha values at zero, mid-scale, and maximum Q0.8 codes.
scenarios.pass_condition: discounted and updated results match the reference model for all selected extremes.

verification.pass_condition: testbench prints TEST_PASS and no TEST_FAIL
